name: bwat
description: bwat in your agent sessions: your hand-off inbox, meetings and transcripts from your company's bwat, over a local MCP server.

base_url.title: bwat API base URL
base_url.description: Your company's bwat address, for example https://bwat.example.com (the plugin adds /v1). Ask whoever set up bwat. For bwat running on this computer, use http://127.0.0.1:8080 (plain http works only with 127.0.0.1, not localhost).
